summary: Added docshelf/access.py per docs/access.md and moved every access check of list, show, edit, share, delete and audit into it, each command now has its own RULES. The original and refactored packages gave identical stdout, stderr, exit status and workspace files on 18000 randomized cases; tests pass (28), including new tests/test_access.py. Existing quirks (differing until-minute, suspension-day, role-case, blank-team, wildcard-grant and delegate rules per command) were kept as they were, not fixed.
